Resolves #19158

A guard now fails on any new path into `resources/content` that engine code under `apps/`, `buildScripts/` or `src/` spells from literals.
- **What counts as spelled from literals:** one string or template literal, consecutive literal arguments of one call (`path.join(root, 'resources', 'content')`), or consecutive literal operands of one `+` chain. Each path is recorded once, where the literals first form it.
- **Why a literal counts:** a relative path is resolved against the working directory, a `projectRoot`, `__dirname` or a base path, so the spelled path is the derivation.
- **Out of a static guard's reach:** a path assembled from non-literal values. The JSDoc and #19158's Contract Ledger both say so.
- **Comments don't count:** the parse drops them. The detector is a regex, so the guard scans its own module too.
- **Baseline:** the census's 34 existing literals in 12 files, ratcheting in both directions.
- **The other ACs** are on the ticket: the census is AC-1, and the leaves are AC-3.

Evidence: L2 (the unit rule arms in CI, plus the guard run on the real tree with mutations for each detection form and both ratchet directions) → L2 required (AC-2 is the guard's own behaviour; AC-1 and AC-3 are ticket artifacts).

|---|---|

| AC-2 | CI: `Content Root Derivation Lint` runs the guard on the tree, where green means the census is debt. `checkContentRootDerivations.spec.mjs` has 11 arms:<br>• each detection form: a literal, a template, split call arguments, and a `+` chain onto a root;<br>• one finding per path;<br>• the non-literal boundary;<br>• the guard's own module scanning clean;<br>• both ratchet directions.<br>Outside CI, the guard went red on the real tree for each form; see Test Evidence. [Contract Ledger](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19158) on the ticket. |
| AC-3 | Ticket: [IC 5815757771](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19158#issuecomment-5815757771) maps each repoint group to its leaf: #19166, neomjs/neo-agent-brain#459 and neomjs/middleware-v2#15. neomjs/neo-agent-brain#457 carries the invariant. All are linked under #17416. |

## Deltas from ticket
- **Scope:** `.mjs` code under `apps/`, `buildScripts/` and `src/`. Workflow and ignore-file entries are path rules, not readers, and they leave with #19159.
- **Every spelled path counts,** not only `path.resolve` shapes, so the report strings in `analyzeClosedSinceRelease.mjs` and `dataSyncWatchdog.mjs` are in the baseline.
- **Wiring follows `check-engine-brain-boundary`:** a lint-staged entry plus a CI mirror, and `check-guard-ci-parity` holds the mirror's `paths:` to `SCAN_SURFACE`.

## Test Evidence
On the real tree at `6ae62557cf`:
- **Green:** `check-content-root-derivations: OK — 34 baselined literal(s) in 12 file(s); 920 file(s) scanned`. The widened detector finds no split-argument or `+`-joined path in the tree, so the census missed none.
- **Every arm below exits 1 naming its site; each was restored, and the control went green again:**
  - a template literal `` `${Neo.config.basePath}resources/content/issues` `` in `src/util/String.mjs` (at `a9f75cde53`);
  - `path.join(root, 'resources', 'content', 'issues')` in the same file;
  - `'resources/content/self'` inside the guard's own module;
  - `check-package-contents.mjs`'s `'resources/content/'` changed, which fails downward.
- **Red first:** at `a9f75cde53`, the four new spec arms were red (split arguments, the `+` chain, one finding per path, and the guard's own module). The non-literal boundary pin was green before and after.
- **An invalid arm, not counted:** a first upward arm edited `isEntryModule.mjs`, which the guard imports, so its exit 1 was a `ReferenceError`.
- **Other checks:** `check-guard-ci-parity` passes. The unit run of the new spec plus `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util` passes.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] None beyond CI: the mirror runs on every PR that touches the scanned trees, and a leaf that repoints a reader fails until its rows leave the baseline.

## Commits
- `a9f75cde53`: the guard, baseline, spec, workflow and lint-staged entry.
- `6ae62557cf`: detection of split call arguments and `+` chains, with no self-exemption (review R1).
